title: Jaheira's Chest Key
summary: Unlocks the wooden chest across from the entrance to Elerrathin’s Home.

fields.Use: Use this key or pass a DC 10 Sleight of Hand check. The chest holds gold, a Trap Disarm Toolkit and a letter to Rion.
fields.Acquisition: Rion carries the key in Act Three.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
